1. Extract the ZIP into a folder.
2. Double-click ArcamedReports.exe.
3. Select the trial balance Excel file as the input. (Real Estate Financials)
4. Select your existing RE Only Excel workbook as the template (Combined Financials)
5. Select Mapping.csv as the mapping file that came in the zip 
		^(It's for flexibility, shouldn't have to mess with right now)
6. Choose an output folder. Default destination is in the same folder as the input trial balance.
7. Enable partial output for now. (can be disabled to prevent empty records)
8. Click Run.
8. Open the generated file (such as TB_August.xlsx) in Excel and save it to refresh formulas.
Your original files will stay unchanged. If the app reports missing mappings, update the mapping file and run again.
Optional: click Audit PDF to save a readable report of any issues.
